## History

Alec visited [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) to deliver the news that John Douglas's mother was dying. Shortly after his announcement, the mother passed away, leading to her funeral. Following these events, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) was finally able to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P41](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0041), [v3 ch.Lady P49](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0049), [v3 ch.Lady P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050), [v3 ch.Lady P51](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0051), [v3 ch.Lady P53](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0053), [v3 ch.Lady P55](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0055), +204 more_

## Relationships

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alec and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) are rivals competing for the affections of [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) back in her hometown. Their dynamic is defined by this mutual rivalry as both men attempt to court her at the same time. During [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's visit to Phil's home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), both suitors actively pursue [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), contributing to her ongoing indecision about her romantic future.

- Rival of — rival suitors for Phil Gordon  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Speaks P5](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0005)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

Alec acts as one of [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's enthusiastic suitors from her home town of [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). He courts her persistently alongside his rival [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), contributing to Phil's reluctance to settle down and choose between her romantic options. During Anne's two-week visit to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), Alec actively pursues [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), maintaining a lively dynamic with her.

- Romantically involved with — suitor  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), +1 more</sub>
